translations.web: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
translations.bsb: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rise against their parents and have them put to death.
translations.kjv: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death, and the father the son; and children shall rise up against their parents, and shall cause them to be put to death.
translations.asv: And brother shall deliver up brother to death, and the father his child; and children shall rise up against parents, and cause them to be put to death.
